behaviors.description: Read a manually installed same-origin extension inside its app sandbox.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app, runtime and optional data extension in one repository; no host filesystem grants.
behaviors.expected: The live app cannot read the marker before installation or after removal. Between them it reads the exact extension marker, reports its commit and sees a read-only mount at /app/data; installation origin matches the app's.

behaviors.description: Use an extension installed from another remote name for the same repository.
behaviors.preconditions: App installed from queries; optional extension explicitly installed from extensions; both remotes have the identical fixture repository URL.
behaviors.expected: Extension origin is extensions. Only while installed, the app reads the exact marker, reports the extension commit and sees its read-only mount. This does not assert installed-related API enumeration.

behaviors.description: Use an extension installed from a genuinely separate repository.
behaviors.preconditions: queries contains only app and runtime; extensions contains only a separately exported extension with distinct marker bytes. App metadata disables automatic download.
behaviors.expected: The app remains runnable without the extension. Explicit installation from extensions exposes its exact distinct marker, commit and read-only mount inside the sandbox; removal makes them disappear. No available-related or installed-related API result is inferred from runtime use.

mappings.rationale: The metadata's default command reports A in all three installation states; its read mode separately proves extension data visibility without adding a new coverage denominator.
A live default app command and exact sandbox reads distinguish successful cross-origin extension use from installation success alone; no library enumeration credit is claimed.
The metadata command remains live before installation and after removal; while installed it consumes extension-only bytes from an independently exported repository.
